jobs.title: Control Center Modernization Program Manager
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description: Who we are Elia Grid International (EGI) is a global engineering consultancy company, part of Elia Group (Belgium) and 50Hertz (Germany), specialising in complex power system challenges. Our goal is to provide high-quality solutions for the challenges of the energy transition. Our multidisciplinary team of experts offer strategic, technical, and regulatory advice in all fields related to power transmission, as well as a range of specialist solutions to a diverse and international client base in the power sector. Elia Grid International has offices in Belgium, Germany, the United Arab Emirates (UAE), the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), Malaysia and Canada. Your function EGI wishes to reinforce its team working on Smart Grids Design & Digitalization. We are seeking a strategic and experienced Program Manager to oversee the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of Energy Management System (EMS) and Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS) implementation programs. The ideal candidate will act as the single point of accountability for integrating both platforms within the utility’s control center and field environments. This cross-functional leadership role requires strong coordination across engineering, IT/OT, vendors, and internal functional departments. Typical Activities Involve (but Are Not Limited To) Program Governance & Execution Lead overall program planning and scheduling for parallel EMS and ADMS implementation streams. Establish program charters, governance structures, risk management plans, and milestone tracking. Ensure on-time, within-budget, and scope-compliant delivery across both EMS and ADMS tracks. Vendor & Stakeholder Management Coordinate with vendors delivering EMS/ADMS solutions. Manage external interfaces including SCADA, DERMS, cybersecurity teams, substations, and system operators. Facilitate alignment between internal stakeholders (transmission, distribution, IT/OT, operations) and external implementation teams. Technical Oversight & Integration Support technical leads in ensuring seamless integration of EMS with ADMS, SCADA, OMS, DERMS, and planning tools. Oversee model management (CIM, topology, signal lists) and data migration plans between legacy and new systems. Monitor testing phases (FAT/SAT), cutover plans, and operational readiness assessments. Compliance, Cybersecurity & Quality Ensure adherence to regulatory frameworks (e.g., NERC CIP, FERC Order 2222, IEC 61850, IEEE 1547, OpenADR). Oversee implementation of cybersecurity frameworks and OT/IT policy integration. Drive quality assurance across program lifecycle and maintain comprehensive documentation. Change Management & Communication Develop and execute change management strategy for operators, engineers, and IT teams. Conduct program-level reporting, steering committee updates, and stakeholder workshops. Oversee training rollout, knowledge transfer, and post-implementation support planning. Your responsibilities will be decided based on your competencies and expertise and will be discussed during your interviews with managers. Your profile Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or relevant technical field. 15+ years of experience managing large-scale utility modernization programs Strong understanding of grid operations, system modelling, real-time applications, and utility business processes. PMP or PRINCE2 certification is preferred; Agile/SAFe knowledge is a plus. Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder engagement skills. Fluent in English; What we offer Permanent contract; Attractive salary package and an extensive array of fringe benefits; Exciting, professional and international environment in a fast-growing company; Unique training, personal development and growth opportunities; At EGI, we value diversity and inclusion. We are firmly committed to promoting gender equality in all aspects of our organization, from recruitment to professional development. We believe that diverse teams are more creative, innovative, and high-performing. Join us to contribute to an environment where everyone has equal opportunities for growth and fulfilment. Choose EGI and help us guide the worldwide power sector into a future of clean and sustainable energy, smarter and more flexible grids, decentralised production and HVDC systems that span across seas and land to interconnect countries, regions, and different energy markets for the benefit of generations to come. Location Abu Dhabi– Mobility required: 30% worldwide (willingness to travel abroad for international assignments depending on the business development or project needs). Want to know more about us? Check our website and our LinkedIn page for last news and updates.

jobs.title: Global Principal Electrical Design Engineer - Data Center Segment
jobs.description: Eaton has been a key player in the Middle East for 40 years. In July 2024, we announced the construction of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, which will bring together our commercial, manufacturing, and support functions, providing room for future growth. About Eaton Eaton is a power management company where we provide energy-efficient solutions that help our customers effectively manage electrical, hydraulic and mechanical power more efficiently, safely and sustainably. Eaton is dedicated to improving the quality of life and the environment through the use of power management technology and services. Eaton has approximately 96,000 employees and sells products to customers in more than 175 countries. Eaton's Global Data Center Segment is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high-performing, sustainable and cost-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed-to-market. With our digital intelligence, world-class cyber-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for a Global Principal Electrical Design Engineer – Data Center Segment. The role serves as Eaton’s senior technical authority for electrical system design across global data center and mission‑critical projects. The role provides strategic and hands‑on engineering leadership from early concept development through detailed design, construction, and project closeout, ensuring technical excellence, safety, compliance, and scalability across global regions. This role influences Eaton’s global electrical design direction, standards, and best practices while supporting complex hyperscale and enterprise data center programs and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, clients, and regional engineering organizations. What You’ll Do Global Electrical Design Authority Act as global subject matter expert and technical authority for electrical systems within Eaton’s Data Centre portfolio. Lead and support the design of complex electrical infrastructure for hyperscale and enterprise data centers from concept through execution. Provide expert guidance on MV and LV distribution, transformers, UPS architecture, protection and coordination, grounding, and system resilience strategies. Standards, Governance & Design Quality Develop, implement, and govern global electrical design standards, reference architectures, and quality frameworks. Ensure all designs align with North American standards (NEC, NFPA, IEEE, UL) and applicable IEC and international standards. Perform peer reviews and validation of electrical engineering deliverables across regions to ensure consistency, compliance, and technical rigor. Serve as final escalation point for complex or high‑risk electrical design challenges. Global Project & Stakeholder Engagement Collaborate within a multidisciplinary global engineering environment on projects of varying complexity and scale. Support bids, proposals, and execution phases by providing advanced electrical engineering expertise. Represent Eaton as a senior technical authority in internal and client-facing meetings, workshops, and design reviews. Participate in global site visits to assess electrical installations, construction quality, and commissioning readiness. Innovation, Value Engineering & Continuous Improvement Lead value engineering initiatives to optimize cost, performance, reliability, and constructability while maintaining system resilience. Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies and architectures in response to increasing power densities, AI/HPC loads, and resilience requirements. Contribute to continuous improvement of global electrical design approaches and delivery models. Knowledge Sharing & Technical Leadership Mentor and support the development of electrical engineering capability across global teams. Promote best practices, technical rigor, and consistent electrical design methodologies across regions and business units. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from an accredited institution. 10+ years of electrical engineering experience with significant exposure to mission‑critical facilities and data center environments. Skills Deep expertise in MV/LV distribution systems, UPS architectures, transformers, grounding, protection schemes, and system coordination. Strong working knowledge of North American electrical codes (NEC, NFPA, IEEE, UL) and IEC standards. Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior technical authority within global, matrixed organizations. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and clients. Proven capability in program management, change management execution, and governance across global or matrixed organizations. Proven experience operating at a global or enterprise level, supporting multi‑region delivery models. Lead clarification and resolution of complex technical, commercial, and execution issues. Escalate effectively when required, ensuring speed, transparency, and leadership alignment. Ability to travel internationally as required. Strong technical, commercial, and analytical capability. Proven leadership, stakeholder engagement, and cross‑regional collaboration skills. Self‑directed with strong decision‑making and problem‑solving ability Fluent in English with the ability to engage effectively with diverse global teams. What We Offer You Being part of a company that has been in business for more than 100 years, is well known in the industry, and has a major impact on the energy industry Work in a company that is commitment to Inclusion & Diversity and Sustainability Annual mentoring program, Eaton University, a reward, and recognition system Ongoing Learning and Career Development Opportunities in a global company. Build your career and apply internally for our open positions worldwide Strong, agile and diverse team locally and globally Strong processes and state-of-the-art systems and tools Structured employee development processes, open feedback culture with development plans Detailed induction support and well-structured onboarding Balance your work and life with a hybrid worktime model Living and Working in Dubai Dubai is a vibrant, cosmopolitan city known for its modern architecture, luxurious lifestyle, and rich cultural heritage. Living and working in Dubai offers an exceptional quality of life with world-class amenities, a safe environment, and a thriving expatriate community. Experience a dynamic blend of work and leisure in one of the world’s most exciting cities. Ready to make a difference? Join Eaton’s Dubai Team and be part of a company shaping the future of sustainable manufacturing and power management! We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

The role will provide leadership to the multidisciplinary PMC team and act as a key interface between ADNOC Offshore, EPC/EPCI contractors, subcontractors, vendors and other project stakeholders . Current ADNOC Offshore PMC requirements specifically emphasize leadership of multidisciplinary teams and management across engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, offshore installation, commissioning and handover. Act as the primary PMC interface with ADNOC Offshore, EPC/EPCI contractors, subcontractors and key stakeholders. Ensure successful delivery of project objectives in accordance with ADNOC requirements and the approved project execution strategy. Establish project priorities, governance, responsibilities and performance expectations. Lead project progress reviews and management meetings with ADNOC Offshore and contractors. Ensure effective coordination and integration between all engineering disciplines and project functions. Review and monitor EPC/EPCI contractor performance against approved schedules and project objectives. Ensure engineering deliverables, procurement activities and construction activities are properly coordinated. Monitor critical project milestones and ensure appropriate corrective or recovery measures are implemented when required. Ensure effective management of interfaces between contractors, vendors, engineering teams, fabrication yards, offshore teams and operations. Oversee project completion and handover activities. Provide management with regular updates covering progress, schedule, cost, risks, opportunities and key project issues. Lead the resolution of major technical, contractual, commercial and execution issues. Ensure critical matters requiring management or client intervention are escalated appropriately. Coordinate with contractor management teams to ensure timely decision-making and resolution of project constraints. HSE & Quality Demonstrate strong and visible leadership in Health, Safety, Security and Environmental performance. Ensure HSE requirements are incorporated throughout all phases of project execution. Promote a strong safety culture within PMC and contractor organizations. Ensure contractor compliance with project quality requirements, inspection and testing plans and applicable ADNOC requirements. Monitor quality performance and ensure timely resolution of significant quality issues and NCRs. Current PMC requirements specifically highlight HSE leadership and compliance with project quality and inspection/testing requirements. Project Controls, Cost & Schedule Maintain overall oversight of project schedule, progress and cost performance. Review and challenge EPC contractor schedules, forecasts, progress measurement and recovery plans. Monitor critical path activities and major milestones. Review project cost forecasts and performance reports. Identify and manage project risks, opportunities, changes and potential claims. Ensure effective management, cost control, forecasting and commercial governance. Contracts & Contractor Management Monitor EPC/EPCI contractor performance and ensure compliance with contractual obligations. Review contractor progress, deliverables and performance against agreed KPIs and milestones. Support the assessment of variations, orders, claims and contractual matters. Ensure timely identification and mitigation of contractual and commercial risks. Coordinate with Contracts and Commercial teams on major contractual issues. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering from a recognized university. Postgraduate qualification in Engineering/Project Management would be an advantage. PMP or equivalent Project Management certification is preferred. Experience Requirements Extensive experience in the Oil & Gas industry, with substantial experience in major offshore projects. Proven experience in a senior Project Manager / PMC Project Manager / Project Director-level environment. Strong experience in PMC/Client-side project management and EPC/EPCI contractor supervision. Coordinar la actividad diaria de producción, asegurando el cumplimiento de la planificación y el uso adecuado de los recursos. Gestionar el equipo de planta, organizando las necesidades operativas y de personal, coordinando la actividad diaria y dando soporte en la resolución de incidencias. Colaborar con los diferentes departamentos para garantizar la disponibilidad de materiales y la continuidad del proceso productivo. Se valorará formación y experiencia en Lean Manufacturing y metodologías de mejora continua. Idiomas: Castellano y catalán nativos. Inglés (valorable). Si quieres seguir desarrollando tu carrera profesional en el ámbito de la gestión de operaciones y la producción industrial, ¡queremos conocerte!

jobs.title: Automation Technical Leader
jobs.description: ¿Te gustaría formar parte de una empresa global líder en innovación y tecnología intralogística? Mecalux es una de las empresas más destacadas a nivel mundial en el mercado de sistemas de almacenaje, con más de 60 años de experiencia. Es pionera en la implementación de tecnologías avanzadas para el diseño, fabricación y comercialización de soluciones logísticas, incluyendo almacenes automáticos, software de gestión y estanterías metálicas. Puesta en marcha de máquinas automáticas y sistemas de control. Solución de problemas y eliminación de fallas, eliminación de alteraciones en los equipos y dispositivos de automatización. Configuración e implementación de dispositivos, de elementos o dispositivos de ponderación, escáner de código de barras, dispositivos de medición. Al menos 4 años de experiencia en puestas en marcha. Conocimientos en Programación de PLC, HMI y SCADA. Operación de Convertidores de Frecuencia (preferiblemente SEW y Lenze). Red Fieldbus (Profibus, Profinet). Nivel medio-alto de inglés. Disponibilidad para viajar asiduamente a nivel nacional e internacional. Se ofrece: Participación en proyectos innovadores y de gran interés profesional, con una de las empresas líderes del sector. Integración en equipos altamente cualificados y en constante evolución. Un entorno de trabajo colaborativo, dinámico y de crecimiento continuo. Altas posibilidades de evolución y crecimiento profesional dentro de una empresa global. Contrato indefinido y jornada completa con flexibilidad horaria. Un salario competitivo, acorde con la experiencia y el perfil de cada candidato/a. Plan de retribución flexible. Te brindamos la oportunidad de impulsar tu carrera en el dinámico sector de la logística, uno de los más prometedores en la actualidad. Si buscas crecer profesionalmente en un entorno de constante evolución, ¡nos encantaría contar contigo en nuestro equipo! En Mecalux tenemos un compromiso con la igualdad de género. Por ello, nuestra voluntad es promover activamente la participación de mujeres y hombres en nuestros procesos de selección y así mismo, garantizar que éstos sean justos y objetivos sin distinción de sexo, orientación, identidad, colectivo, expresión de género o cualquier otra característica protegida por ley.

Develop and maintain relationships with contractors, subcontractors, vendors, and other stakeholders , as applicable. Experience developing and managing project scope, budgets, timelines, and resource allocation . Experience monitoring and managing variations and EOTs . Experience coordinating baseline schedules with Planning Engineers. Strong experience handling correspondence and coordination with clients, consultants, contractors, subcontractors, vendors, site teams, and internal departments . Experience coordinating MEP works in line with project requirements. Experience managing submittals, approvals, site records, project changes, costs, and financial performance . Strong understanding of project quality and safety requirements . Experience coordinating authority inspections and approvals . Experience managing project snagging, final handover, and Work Completion Certificates . Ability to improve project efficiency and support cost reduction.

jobs.title: CEO – MBI Program (Operating Partner) – Spain
jobs.description: If you already know the entrepreneurship-through-acquisition world, here's what's different about this path: MBI is built for operators with a real P&L track record, not a first-time search fund fresh out of business school. You bring the operating experience; AIA brings the capital, the deal structuring, and more flexibility on target profile and deal terms than a traditional search fund allows. This is a Spain-based CEO role, we're looking for candidates with deep, established professional roots in Spain's business community. As a Chief Executive Officer (Operating Partner) in All Interests Aligned's (AIA) Management Buy-In (MBI) Program, you will lead the acquisition and management of a high-potential, family-owned SME in Spain facing a succession challenge. Unlike a traditional job, this is a unique career path, offering you the opportunity to become a CEO-owner of a business, with the backing of investors who are successful entrepreneurs themselves. Working closely with AIA, you'll experience a fully-supported journey across all stages of the MBI process: Origination: Identify and assess potential acquisition targets with AIA's financial and strategic support. During this phase, you will be compensated, ensuring financial stability while you focus on building your acquisition pipeline. Deal Closing: Partner with AIA's investment professionals who lead due diligence, valuation, and deal structuring to secure the acquisition. Transition: Take on the CEO role, with a structured transition plan that includes leadership handover and relationship-building with key stakeholders. Operation: Lead the company's operations, supported by AIA's team in governance, reporting, and compliance to create and execute a value-driven growth plan. Exit: Prepare and execute an exit strategy in partnership with AIA, maximizing returns and ensuring a sustainable future for the business. Industries & Investment Criteria AIA's investment focus is on cash-flow positive, owner-operated SMEs across industries such as: Consumer Products (F&B only) Industrial Goods Facilities Management Testing, Inspection and Certification (TIC) Energy, utilities & environment Chemicals & Materials Transportation & logistics Wellness & Nutrition (both Human & Animal) Adult Learning Ideal acquisition targets meet the following criteria Enterprise sales of between €10–40 million Consistent history of generating free cash flow (minimum 10% of sales) Established or stable growth, with a strong competitive position in underserved markets These investment standards ensure that each acquisition aligns with AIA's mission to solve the SME succession crisis in Europe. Selection Process Admission to the AIA MBI Program is rigorous, ensuring a strong fit between future CEOs and AIA's mission. The multi-stage process includes leadership assessments, in-depth interviews, a business case, development of an investment thesis, and a final presentation to a panel of AIA leaders and external experts. The selection process typically spans 15–17 weeks, requiring 35–40 hours of preparation. Job Requirements Experience: A minimum of 5 years in a general management role with full P&L accountability, not just influence over it: if the business goes south, the consequences are yours to carry, not a superior's. Combined with at least 10–15 years of post-undergraduate professional experience. Operating background required: This program is built for hands-on operators. It isn't a fit for candidates whose background is primarily in financial services, banking, private equity, or consulting without direct, operating P&L accountability. Industry Expertise: A proven track record of success and deep domain knowledge in a sector that aligns with AIA's investment thesis and strategic priorities, across various business types (corporates and SMEs). Local Anchorage: Strong regional insight with fluency in local language and business culture, supported by a deep understanding of the economy and a well-established network in the chosen geography. Entrepreneurial Mindset: Demonstrate resilience, resourcefulness, and the ability to navigate and overcome significant business challenges to achieve strong outcomes. Emotional Readiness: Prepared to take on a leadership role, with clarity of purpose, a strong vision for growth, and a commitment to making a lasting impact. Balanced Ambition: A combination of humility and strong personal drive, anchored by a clear understanding of how partnering with AIA can accelerate both individual and business success through purposeful collaboration. jobs.title: Director of Operations, Slate Development
jobs.description: Scopely is looking for a Director, Slate Operations to join our Slate Development Group team in the UK remotely or in Barcelona, on a flexible hybrid model. At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. Slate Operations keeps Scopely's game development slate moving. We oversee execution and cross-functional alignment across the games in development — connecting game teams and central teams so decisions get made once and stick, running the cadence that keeps everyone aligned, and clearing the path so teams can build. What You'll Do We're looking for a Director, Slate Operations to own this end to end. There are two sides to it: keeping the Group running as an organization — its cadence, process, and the day-to-day support the Game Board, Head of Slate Development and leadership team rely on — and running program management for the Game Development Framework (GDF) so games move cleanly from concept to launch. You'll sit inside the Slate Development Group but work with every part of Scopely: game teams, divisional leadership, finance, strategy, and corporate development. Be the operational point of contact for specific in-development games — running the GDF cadence and connecting game and central teams so decisions get made once and aren't re-litigated. The main goal is to be the end to end steward for game teams in the game development framework. Deliver operational excellence within our internal team, shaping our service model, priorities, and ways of working. Evolve our capabilities as needs change. Drive the cross-slate operating model so independent game teams reuse what already works instead of rebuilding it. Bring structure to consequential decisions — organize the inputs, assumptions, and trade-offs early so the owners and the room can reach real alignment before committing. Own a capstone project — one meaty area you drive end to end, for example: evolving the GDF, owning launch readiness, or operationalizing central partnerships, depending on where the need is. Keep investment decisions well-informed — track progress across games at different stages, and surface Greenlight Case, budget, staffing, and dependency status so leadership can challenge and decide. Unblock teams through the development cycle, especially at launch readiness, by clearing operational issues with central partners (legal, IT, procurement, finance, logistics) so teams stay focused on the game. Partner with marketing, strategy, and divisional leadership so launches go out clean. Give teams operational support — production perspective, process, facilitation, and help navigating the GDF. Operationalize playtests and validation — help build and run research, playtest, and validation plans, and package the findings so vertical owners and leaders can form the recommendation. Utilize the latest AI technologies to keep information flowing — the dashboards, status, and key dates people need to see, without the overhead. What We’re Looking For Bachelor's degree, MBA a plus — or the equivalent in experience. 10+ years in program/project management across tech and direct-to-consumer businesses, at least 5 of them in games, working within or alongside a development team. You know how games get made and sold — development, publishing, platforms, business models. You don't need to have shipped one yourself, but you get what game teams are up against. You've supported senior execs in a fast-moving environment and you like the pace — taking initiative, juggling priorities, switching gears without losing the thread. You can run a lot of projects at once, ideally a mix of R&D and live. You're comfortable in ambiguity and good at creating clarity for other people. You make sound calls in the company's interest and know when to escalate. You can hold your own with P&Ls and free-to-play KPIs. You spot the process that's slowing people down and fix it — and you'll push back and start the right debate when it matters. You build trust with all kinds of people at every level and don't flinch at the hard conversations — with the presence to grow into a partner to senior game leaders over time. You write clearly and fast, and you can build a strong deck with cross-functional input. Detail and organization come naturally to you. Low ego, business outcomes first, open to feedback — and genuinely curious about every part of the business. You play games and care about the industry. About Scopely Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come. Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play. Champion DataOps practices: CI/CD, pipeline versioning, testing, lineage, observability, and deployment automation. Responsibilities - Stakeholder & Strategy: Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to explore new use cases and translate business requirements into technical solutions. Solid experience working within the life sciences industry (e.g., clinical trials, regulatory submissions, pharmacovigilance, R&D data, or commercial operations), with a strong grasp of the domain’s data complexity, standards, and compliance requirements. jobs.title: Product Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Join us at Wolters Kluwer and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day. We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most. We are currently looking for a Product Software Engineering Manager to join our team. About the role: As a Product Software Engineering Manager , you will manage a team of software engineers, overseeing the development, implementation, and enhancement of commercial products. You will be accountable for the performance and results of your team, driving successful projects that align with business objectives. Your role is critical in ensuring that the software solutions are innovative, reliable, and scalable. Responsibilities: Lead and manage a sizable team of software engineers, fostering a positive and high-performing work culture. Provide expert guidance in solving complex technical challenges and making critical project decisions. Communicate effectively in a matrixed organization with senior management, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and collaboration. Foster the growth and development of software engineering teams, providing mentoring and coaching to team members. Oversee the adherence to quality standards and best practices throughout the software development process. Provide leadership and mentorship to team members, fostering their professional growth and development. Collaborate with other teams and functions to facilitate seamless integration and successful product launches. Conduct regular performance evaluations of team members, providing feedback and identifying areas for improvement. Plan and schedule work within the team, ensuring efficient resource utilization and meeting project timelines. Monitor development processes, framework adoption, and project progress to ensure efficiency and compliance with standards. Monitor ongoing processes, materials, or surroundings, providing feedback for improvement. Estimate project resources and allocate them effectively to meet project demands. Skills: DevOps: An ability to use systems and processes to coordinate between development and operations teams in order to improve and speed up software development processes. This includes automation, continuous delivery, agility, and rapid response to feedback. Product Software Engineering: The ability to design, develop, test, and deploy software products. It involves understanding user needs, defining functional specifications, designing system architecture, coding, debugging, and ensuring product quality. It also requires knowledge of various programming languages, tools and methodologies, and ability to work within diverse teams and manage projects. Cloud Computing: The ability to utilize and manage applications, data, and services on the internet rather than on a personal computer or local server. This skill involves understanding various cloud services (like AWS, Google Cloud, Azure), managing resources online, and setting up cloud-based platforms for business environment. Implementation and Delivery: This is a skill that pertains to the ability to translate plans and designs into action. It involves executing strategies effectively, overseeing the delivery of projects or services, and ensuring they are completed in a timely and efficient manner. It also necessitates the coordination of various tasks and management of resources to achieve the set objectives. Problem Solving: The ability to understand a complex situation or issue and devise a solution by defining the problem, identifying potential strategies, and ultimately choosing and implementing the most effective course of action. People management: The ability to lead, motivate, engage and communicate effectively with a team. This includes skills in delegation, conflict resolution, negotiation, and understanding team dynamics. It also involves building a strong team culture and managing individual performance. Agile: The ability to swiftly and effectively respond to changes, with an emphasis on continuous improvement and flexibility. In the context of project management, it denotes a methodology that promotes adaptive planning and encourages rapid and flexible responses to changes. APIs: The ability to design, develop, and manage Application Programming Interfaces, which constitute the set of protocols and tools used for building application software. This skill includes the capacity to create and maintain high-quality API documentation, implement API security practices, and understand API testing techniques. Additionally, having this ability means understanding how APIs enable interaction between different software systems, allowing them to communicate with each other. Analysis: The ability to examine complex situations or problems, break them down into smaller parts, and understand how these parts work together. Automation: The ability to design, implement, manage, and optimize automated systems or processes, often using various software tools and technologies. This skill includes understanding both the technical elements and the business implications of automated systems. Frameworks: The ability to understand, utilise, and create structured environments for software development. This skill also involves being able to leverage existing frameworks to streamline processes, ensuring better efficiency and code manageability in software development projects. Join us, at Wolters Kluwer, and be part of a global technology company that makes a difference every day. Be the difference. If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. jobs.title: Salesforce Project Manager
jobs.description: The purpose of this role is to drive and oversee the delivery of the assigned projects to ensure that the objectives are clearly defined and achieved within the agreed time, cost and quality constraints. Job Description: Omega CRM, a Merkle & Dentsu company, is a leader in Customer Experience services with over 20 years of experience leveraging technology for marketing and driving innovative customer relationships. We are currently looking for a Project Manager to join our team Main duties : Provide support in the pre-sales tasks of assigned accounts: solution design, estimation, planning, and assumptions. Share with the project team the client's vision, objectives, and expectations. Assign and supervise team tasks, managing assignments, vacations, and absences during the project. Manage project progress to ensure deadlines, scope, and budget are met. Facilitate change requests to ensure all parties are informed of schedule and budget impacts. Provide visibility of project progress to the client and Customer Success Manager (CSM). Lead follow-up meetings and steering committees. Alert operations management of potential deviations. Establish communication and risk mitigation plans. Monitor all incoming and outgoing project documentation. Ensure project deliverables adhere to quality standards. Lead project demos for the client. Lead the resolution of issues arising from project implementation. Lead the relationship and pursue customer satisfaction regarding the project. Ensure project objectives are met. Evaluate the project afterward and identify successful and unsuccessful project elements. Responsible for sending customer satisfaction surveys regarding the project. Identify potential Up & Cross-Selling opportunities for the account. Lead team retrospectives and identify potential internal improvements. Participate in the development, training, and supervision of the assigned team, providing guidance to improve their skills. Experience needed : +5 years of experience in Project Management roles, successfully leading Salesforce projects. +3 years of experience participating in end-to-end CRM implementation processes. Solid hands-on experience working with Salesforce Service Cloud and Marketing Cloud. Proven experience working with Agile methodologies (SCRUM) and project management tools like Jira. Professional proficiency in English (Medium-High level, capable of fluent business communication). What Do We Offer Permanent contract. Flexible Schedule. We make it easy. Balance your professional and personal life. Certifications plan. Improve your skills and get the official certificate from our main partners. Home Office. You decide and we support you. Flexible retribution (public transport ticket, Ticket restaurtant, …). Health insurance. OMEGA in action. Our commitment to a better society is not just an intention Professional development: Evolve, grow and get where you want to go. About Us Omega CRM, a Merkle & Dentsu company, is a global digital company specialising in accelerating the Business Experience (BX) of our clients through customer-centric solutions, technology, and data – all enhanced by AI. Together with Merkle, we form the largest Customer Experience Management (CXM) agency in Spain, and as part of the dentsu group, we offer end-to-end solutions that integrate media, creativity, content, technology, and strategy to deliver real business impact. With over 23 years of experience, a team of 580+ professionals from 24 nationalities, and 2,500+ certifications, Omega CRM is a recognised leader in the Salesforce ecosystem in Spain. We operate across key industries including Retail, Healthcare, Pharma, Real Estate, Education, and Non-Profit, delivering omnichannel experiences in Customer Service, eCommerce, Marketing, and Analytics. Client satisfaction is at our core (rating: 4.9/5), and we’ve been recognised with awards such as Salesforce Partner of the Year FY23 and Most Innovative Project (Iberia). At Omega CRM, we believe in growth through people – guided by our values: #Talent, #Flexibility, #Commitment, and #Innovation. We grow #Together. #OMEGA REMOTE Location: Barcelona Brand: Omega Time Type: Full time Contract Type: Permanent

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (GenAI & Agentic Platforms)
jobs.description: We power people’s progress. At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale. Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day. Meet the team! AI Platform provides the shared foundations that help teams across Preply build, ship, and operate AI capabilities safely at scale. The area includes ML Platform, GenAI Platform, and Agentic Platform. You will lead GenAI and Agentic Platform: approximately 8-12 engineers across two teams, while partnering closely with ML Platform leadership. GenAI Platform owns shared model access, routing, evaluation, observability, prompt and configuration lifecycle, retrieval, grounding, and guardrails. Agentic Platform builds on those foundations with durable execution, tools, state, context, memory, permissions, human controls, agent evaluation, and runtime safety. The two teams share a Product Manager. Together, you will shape strategy, priorities, adoption, and outcomes; clarify what belongs in shared infrastructure versus product teams; and evolve the platform as models, frameworks, and company needs change. Learn more through our Engineering Blog, Tech Radar, and YouTube channel. What you’ll be doing: GenAI and Agentic AI are central to Preply's AI strategy. As the Senior Engineering Manager for GenAI & Agentic Platforms, you'll own the engineering strategy, execution, and organizational health of two complementary teams that take AI workloads from experimentation to reliable production systems. This is a multi-team leadership role for a manager with strong technical judgment. You won't be the primary implementer, but you'll go deep on architecture and production AI, coach senior engineers, shape platform abstractions and operational standards, and partner with Product, Applied Science, Data, Security, and Engineering teams. In this role, your responsibilities include: Set the long-term engineering vision for GenAI Platform and the Agentic Platform, ensuring they operate as a single, coherent platform. Partner with the Product Manager across both teams to define outcomes, prioritize investments, and measure the impact of the platforms. Lead and develop approximately 8-12 engineers across two teams through clear expectations, direct feedback, performance management, career growth, and coaching. Own hiring quality, team composition, evolving team boundaries, and operating models as the platforms and company change. Guide architecture across model access, evaluation, observability, retrieval, agent orchestration, tools, state, memory, permissions and control planes. Translate strategy into realistic plans, balancing foundational investment with near-term product needs while surfacing trade-offs and maintaining speed, quality, and predictability. Align senior stakeholders across Product, Applied Science, Data, Security and Engineering on platform standards, build-vs-buy decisions and shared priorities. What you need to succeed: 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years in engineering management and experience leading multiple teams or a multi-squad technical area. A track record of hiring, coaching, and retaining high-performing teams. Strong technical depth in platform engineering, backend or distributed systems, ML infrastructure or developer infrastructure. Practical experience with production GenAI or Agentic systems and the ability to reason about model access, evaluation, observability, retrieval, agent orchestration, tool use, state, permissions, reliability, cost, and safety. AI Expertise: You use Agentic AI beyond code generation to support architecture, planning, and decision-making, while retaining human judgment for architecture, people decisions, business logic, and security, and establishing quality gates and safety nets for team workflows. Experience leading platform products, with a strong instinct for self-service, API design, developer experience, adoption and avoiding unnecessary complexity. Clear communication and stakeholder leadership, with the ability to align teams with different incentives, make sound decisions with incomplete information and revisit assumptions as the ecosystem changes. Nice to have: Experience managing teams that built AI or ML platforms used by multiple teams. Experience with agent frameworks or durable workflow technologies such as LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, or Temporal. Hands-on familiarity with GenAI evaluation and observability, prompt or model lifecycle, retrieval systems, multi-provider routing or open-model serving. Experience making build-vs-buy decisions without locking the organization into one provider or framework. Experience measuring platform success through adoption, customer outcomes, and engineering leverage rather than infrastructure delivery alone. Why you’ll love it at Preply: An open, collaborative, dynamic, and diverse culture; A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget, and time off for your self-development; A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance; Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub Access to free mental health support platforms; Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health; The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!). Our Principles Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing. We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners are why we do what we do. Every day we focus on empowering tutors to deliver an exceptional learning experience. Keep perfecting - To create an outstanding customer experience, we focus on simplicity, smoothness, and enjoyment, continually perfecting it as every detail matters. Now is the time - In a fast-paced world, it matters how quickly we act. Now is the time to make great things happen. Disciplined execution - What makes us disciplined is the excellence in our execution. We set clear goals, focus on what matters, and utilize our resources efficiently. Dive deep - We leverage business acumen and curiosity to investigate disparities between numbers and stories, unlocking meaningful insights to guide our decisions. Growth mindset - We proactively seek growth opportunities and believe today's best performance becomes tomorrow's starting point. We humbly embrace feedback and learn from setbacks. Raise the bar - We raise our performance standards continuously, alongside each new hire and promotion. We build diverse and high-performing teams that can make a real difference. Challenge, disagree and commit - We value open and candid communication, even when we don’t fully agree. We speak our minds, challenge when necessary, and fully commit to decisions once made. One Preply - We prioritize collaboration, inclusion, and the success of our team over personal ambitions. Together, we support and celebrate each other's progress. Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Preply.com is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people of diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe that the presence of different opinions and viewpoints is a key ingredient for our success as a multicultural Ed-Tech company. That means that Preply will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age or veteran status.

jobs.title: Co-Founder & CEO - Business, Growth & Go-to-Market
jobs.description: Locality Network es una plataforma tecnológica para comunidades, organizaciones e instituciones, diseñada para gestionar de forma sencilla sus miembros, servicios, participación y economía digital. Locality combina una blockchain pública y descentralizada con una experiencia de usuario similar a las aplicaciones Web2, de forma que las personas puedan utilizar sus servicios sin necesidad de entender blockchain. La plataforma ya permite gestionar votaciones públicas y anónimas, reservas, citas, colas y economías digitales , y está diseñada modularmente para incorporar nuevos servicios sobre la misma infraestructura. La visión es construir una infraestructura común sobre la que diferentes comunidades y organizaciones puedan crear y gestionar sus propios servicios digitales, con transparencia, trazabilidad, reglas verificables y sin depender de una única autoridad. Actualmente estoy en fase pre-seed , con el producto y la infraestructura tecnológica desarrollados, una testnet pública operativa y preparando los primeros programas piloto, inicialmente en Cataluña. La idea es sencilla: Utilizar blockchain como infraestructura, sin que los usuarios tengan que entender blockchain. Una blockchain pública y descentralizada permite construir servicios sobre una infraestructura compartida, verificable y auditable, con registros inmutables y trazables. El reto Yo he construido la tecnología. Ahora busco a la persona que quiera construir el negocio conmigo. Busco un/a Co-Founder & CEO que asuma la responsabilidad de llevar Locality Network al mercado, identificar y validar las primeras oportunidades de negocio, conseguir los primeros clientes y pilotos y construir las bases de la compañía. No busco simplemente a alguien que venda un producto ya creado. Busco a alguien que quiera descubrir dónde Locality puede generar más valor, definir junto conmigo la estrategia de negocio y construir la empresa desde una fase muy temprana. Tú construyes el negocio. Yo construyo la tecnología. Qué harás Identificar y validar los primeros segmentos de mercado y casos de uso. Definir y ejecutar la estrategia go-to-market. Hablar directamente con potenciales clientes y usuarios. Conseguir los primeros pilotos y clientes. Desarrollar relaciones con comunidades, organizaciones e instituciones. Construir partnerships estratégicos. Definir y validar el modelo de negocio y pricing. Liderar ventas B2B e institucionales. Representar Locality Network ante clientes, partners e inversores. Participar en la estrategia de fundraising. A medida que el proyecto crezca, construir y liderar el equipo de negocio. No tendrás un playbook comercial ya definido. Ayudarás a crearlo. Qué ofrezco Esta es una oportunidad para incorporarse como cofundador/a , no como un empleado convencional. Equity de fundador Una participación significativa y de doble dígito en el capital, con peso real en la compañía y acorde al nivel de un cofundador temprano, con vesting y acuerdo de fundadores. Tokens $LOCA Una asignación significativa de tokens $LOCA, dentro de la distribución reservada al equipo fundador y con vesting a largo plazo. Nota: $LOCA es el token nativo de la blockchain de Locality Network y el activo utilizado para pagar las comisiones de las transacciones de la red. Sin aportación económica No espero que el/la cofundador/a tenga que financiar el proyecto con recursos propios. Durante esta fase inicial, yo asumiré personalmente los principales costes del proyecto, incluyendo infraestructura, servidores y promoción. Importante: situación actual Locality Network está en fase pre-seed. Actualmente no existe salario ni compensación económica. Tampoco exijo dedicación full-time desde el primer día. Busco compromiso real y una dedicación suficiente para conseguir los primeros pilotos y construir el negocio. A medida que lleguen pilotos, ingresos o financiación, podremos avanzar hacia una dedicación mayor y unas condiciones económicas acordes a la evolución del proyecto. Encajaremos si... Tienes espíritu emprendedor y te gusta construir desde cero. Disfrutas abriendo puertas, creando relaciones y generando oportunidades. Tienes visión de negocio y capacidad para convertir oportunidades en proyectos concretos. Te sientes cómodo/a trabajando con autonomía e incertidumbre. Quieres asumir responsabilidad y capacidad real de decisión. No es para ti si... Buscas un puesto con salario desde el primer día. Prefieres recibir tareas y objetivos completamente definidos. No disfrutas de la venta, el networking o el desarrollo de negocio. Necesitas una estructura, equipo y procesos ya establecidos. No tienes que imaginarte el producto. Puedes probarlo. Regístrate gratis en la Easy App y descubre por ti mismo lo que ya está construido: 👉 https://easy.locality.network/ Cómo contactar Si te interesa explorar una posible incorporación como cofundador/a, envíame un mensaje breve explicando: Tu experiencia construyendo negocio, desarrollando partnerships, vendiendo o emprendiendo. Qué te atrae de Locality Network. Por qué crees que podríamos complementarnos como cofundadores. No necesitas ser experto/a en blockchain. Necesitas querer construir.

jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description: About Finanshels Finanshels is a fast-growing fintech building the Financial Operating System (FinOS) for SMEs across the MENA region. We automate accounting and tax operations, deliver real-time financial health insights, and build systems which help finance teams scale efficiently. Our product operates across multiple UAE regulatory frameworks, and we build it with a small, high-ownership, AI-native team. THE OPPORTUNITY Our customers experience Finanshels through accounting, taxation, bookkeeping and more — and today that experience is fragmented, manual, and stitched across disconnected systems. Talented builders are shipping AI-powered solutions against individual pieces of it, at speed, but without a unifying product view of the journey those pieces belong to. This role exists to fix that. You will own the customer experience charter on FinOS: replacing a broken, manual journey with automated, productised, and unified experiences across every stage and every service line. Along the way, you will raise the product bar for how the whole team builds — defining the problem, the user, and the measure of success before engineering begins. This is a hands-on role in a startup. You will start as the sole product owner for this charter, reporting to the Head of Product, with scope to build and lead a product team as the function grows. What You'll Own ▸ The End-to-End Customer Journey . Map, diagnose, and rebuild the customer experience across service lines — from first touch through ongoing delivery — turning manual, fragmented steps into unified, productised flows on FinOS. ▸ Automation at the Core . Identify where human effort is absorbing what the product should do, and drive the automation that removes it — measured in customer effort reduced and operational hours freed. ▸ Consolidation onto One Platform . Bring capability scattered across legacy internal systems into a single coherent experience, so customers and the teams serving them work in one place, not many. ▸ Product Standards for AI-Native Building . Raise how the team builds. Bring rigour — clear problem definition, user clarity, success metrics, and evaluation — to AI features that today ship without it. ▸ Prioritisation and Sequencing. Decide what gets built and in what order. Protect the roadmap from work that does not move the metric, and retire builds that have stopped earning their place. ▸ Product Execution. Own roadmap and releases with Engineering, Delivery, Tax and CX. Set standards for accuracy, security, auditability and approvals. Prioritize by hours saved, reliability, customer impact and cost. ▸ Measurement. Define the metrics that describe a healthy customer journey, instrument them with our data and analytics team, and hold the roadmap accountable to them. OWNERSHIP AND AUTONOMY This role carries a clearly defined charter and the authority to run it. Within that charter you are expected to decide — on scope and sequencing, operating cadence and product rituals, user experience and workflow direction, what the team declines to build, and what gets retired. Tooling and vendor decisions sit with you within an agreed budget. Decisions that shift resources beyond your charter, affect pricing or revenue, or cannot be reversed are made jointly with the Head of Product. Everything else is yours. What We're Looking For ▸ Experience . 8+ years in product management, including a period as an early or founding product hire responsible for establishing the function. ▸ Building the Discipline . A demonstrable track record of moving a team from output to outcomes — introducing product practice where it did not previously exist, and making it stick. ▸ Commercial Judgment. You connect every product decision to a business result — revenue earned, cost removed, or time returned — and can defend the trade-off. ▸ Technical Credibility. Engineers regard you as a peer. You hold your own on architecture and data trade-offs and know when technical debt is the right call. ▸ Customer Obsession. You work close to real users — business owners, accountants, tax consultants — and can translate observed friction into shipped improvement. ▸ Journey and Service Design. Proven ability to diagnose experience failure across a complex, multi-stage, partly manual journey and redesign it as a product. ▸ AI Fluency in Practice. You have shipped AI-powered products to production and can speak credibly to evaluation, guardrails, and how you measured whether it worked. ▸ Communication. You write clearly enough that your strategy documents do not need rewriting, and you influence through evidence rather than authority. ▸ Domain (Preferred). Fintech, accounting, tax, or another regulated or professional-services environment. WHY FINANSHELS ▸ Genuine Ownership . Define the customer experience charter from the ground up. ▸ AI-First Mandate. Applied AI is not a side project — it is how we build. ▸ Lean Team, High Impact . Every person and every decision matters. ▸ Fintech at the Right Moment. Finanshels is at an inflection point, and this role will define how we scale. How To Apply Send your CV, along with anything that shows how you build — a strategy document, a before-and-after journey you rebuilt, or a product you are proud of — to careers@finanshels.com.

Currently, reconciliations involve multiple data sources, booking platforms, custodians, settlement systems, and internal ledgers. jobs.title: National Consultant : Domestic and Sustainable Financing for TPSR, SRHR & DD
jobs.description: Job Description Purpose of consultancy: The purpose of this consultancy is to provide expert technical leadership to drive the implementation of the Sustainable Financing Roadmap for Uganda (2026–2030), specifically linked to the Demographic Dividend domestic financing requirements. The consultant will lead evidence generation, strategic policy dialogue aligned with Uganda’s budget calendar, public financial management (PFM) assessments, and institutional capacity development to enable the Government of Uganda to: Spend More: Increase domestic budget allocations and leverage predictable resources for Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights (SRHR), adolescent health, and TPSR implementation through targeted advocacy in Uganda's budget cycle. Spend Better: Diagnose Public Financial Management (PFM) bottlenecks, improve expenditure execution, equity, and efficiency across national and district local government levels. Diversify Financing Sources: Explore innovative financing, results-based mechanisms, private sector engagement, and alignment with International Financial Institutions (IFIs). Institutionalize Systems: Embed financing tools, analytics, and tracking mechanisms directly into government PFM processes to support the transition from aid funding to sustainable domestic financing. Scope of work: Background Sustainable financing is not achieved by isolated fundraising activities. It emerges when robust evidence, effective policy dialogue, stronger public financial management and diversified partnerships reinforce each other to influence government financing decisions. This consultancy will support UNFPA to strengthen Uganda's sustainable financing ecosystem for population and sexual and reproductive health and rights (SRHR). The consultant will support the generation and use of strategic evidence, strengthen institutional capacity, and foster policy dialogue to translate evidence on financing into sustainable public investment and long-term financing reforms. Overall Objective To lead the execution of the UNFPA CPD10 Sustainable Financing Roadmap, integrating financing analytics and driving evidence-informed policy dialogue aligned with the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA) 2015 budget calendar, and Programme-Based Budgeting (PBB) architecture, specifically under the Human Capital Development Programme Working Groups. Specific Objectives & Strategic Pillars Pillar 1: Build the Evidence & Analytics Cost of Inaction & Investment Cases: building on the existing evidence, update, adapt, and generate economic evidence/policy briefs on the cost of inaction regarding teenage pregnancy, SRHR and DD. Budget Notes & Factsheets: Develop targeted budget notes, financing factsheets, and policy briefs to quantify financing gaps and demonstrate Return on Investment (ROI) to key fiscal decision-makers. Fiscal Space & Efficiency Analysis: Identify potential fiscal space opportunities like earmarked health revenues and taxes, and model efficiency gains in current health/social sector spending. Pillar 2: Influence Public Financing – "Spend More" Primary Goal: Drive evidence-informed advocacy across critical decision points in the Ugandan budget calendar to protect, create, and scale domestic budget allocations for DD, SRHR, teenage pregnancy prevention, and TPSR implementation at national and District Local Government (DLG) levels. Q1 Touchpoint (Sept – Dec) | Budget Strategy & Budget Framework Papers (BFPs): 1st Budget Call Circular (BCC1) Engagement (Sept–Oct): Work with the Ministry of Health (Adolescent & School Health Division) and the Human Capital Development (HCD) Programme Working Group (PWG) to ensure adolescent SRHR and TPSR priorities are integrated into the Programme Budget Framework Paper (PBFP) ceilings. District Local Government (DLG) BFP Technical Support (Oct–Nov): Support key pilot/scale-up districts during regional LG budget consultations to ensure UNFPA CPD10 indicative planning figures, TPSR surveillance, and SRHR/DD indicators are captured in DLG BFPs. Cabinet & MoFPED Submissions (Dec 31): Prepare concise Budget Advocacy Briefs for MoFPED ahead of the final National Budget Framework Paper (NBFP) submission to Parliament. UNFPA CPD10 cofinancing MOUs with NPA and DLG (Dec 31): provide technical support to draft and negotiate the co-financing MOUs with MoFPED and MoLG, for the implementation of the UNFPA Country Programme 10. Q2 Touchpoint (Jan – Feb) | Parliamentary Scrutiny of the NBFP: Parliamentary "Budget Champions" Engagement (Jan): Facilitate targeted advocacy roundtables with the Parliamentary Committee on Health, Committee on Gender, Committee on Budget, and the Uganda Women Parliamentary Association (UWOPA) using Cost of Inaction and Investment Case findings. NBFP Recommendations Push (Feb 15): Provide technical inputs and draft memo language to MPs to ensure Parliamentary recommendations on the NBFP mandate higher funding allocations for adolescent health supplies (family planning/contraceptives), SGBV response, and school-based health tracking. Q3 Touchpoint (March – May) | Ministerial Policy Statements (MPS) & Appropriation: 2nd Budget Call Circular (BCC2) & MPS Finalization (March 15): Assist MoH and relevant MDAs in populating the Program Budgeting System (PBS) to ensure specific DD/SRHR/TPSR activity codes and budget lines are retained in the Ministerial Policy Statements. Sectoral Committee Hearings (April 1 – April 20): Equip civil society coalitions, youth champions, and MoH technical teams with analytical briefing kits to defend DD/SRHR lines during MPS sectoral committee reviews. Appropriation Bill Enactment (May 31): Track and verify that final parliamentary appropriations retain approved DD, SRHR and TPSR allocations prior to presidential assent. Pillar 3: Improve Spending Efficiency – "Spend Better" Primary Goal: Diagnose Public Financial Management (PFM) bottlenecks, optimize budget execution rates, and ensure public investments in DD, SRHR and TPSR yield high value-for-money and equitable outcomes across national and local government levels. Budget Execution & Release Tracking (Q1–Q4 Quarterly Cycles): Quarterly Fund Release Audits: Analyze MoFPED quarterly warranting and release performance for health and social development votes to identify delays in operational fund disbursement to central divisions and DLGs. Absorption & Execution Rate Reviews: Assess execution bottlenecks (procurement delays, late IFMS releases, cash flow constraints) affecting adolescent SRHR commodity procurement (NMS/JMS) and district TPSR operations. PFM System Diagnostics & Efficiency Analyses: Public Expenditure & Bottleneck Analysis (PEBA): Conduct a targeted PFM review of how domestic resources flow from MoFPED to MoH, MoES, MoGLSD, MoLG and downstream to District Health Teams (DHTs), health facilities, schools and other committees. Value-for-Money (VfM) & Equity Mapping: Evaluate unit costs and equity distribution of health/social sector spending to ensure funds reach high-burden, vulnerable adolescent populations (applying Leave No One Behind criteria). Efficiency Reallocation Recommendations: Identify operational double-counting or programmatic inefficiencies, providing actionable options to reallocate savings directly into core SRHR/DD/TPSR surveillance and response activities. Pillar 4: Diversify Financing Sources Primary Goal: Broaden the SRHR and adolescent health financing architecture beyond traditional public budgets by leveraging International Financial Institutions (IFIs), results-based mechanisms, and innovative private sector partnerships. IFI Portfolio Alignment (World Bank, AfDB, Global Fund, GFF): Human Capital Development Project Integration: Map ongoing and pipeline IFI loan/grant operations in Uganda (e.g., World Bank health/education projects, UgIFT, UACE) and develop technical briefs to embed TPSR and adolescent health disbursement-linked indicators (DLIs) or results conditions into IFI programs. Results-Based Financing (RBF) & Blended Finance: RBF Framework Design: Formulate concrete options for incorporating adolescent SRHR, teenage pregnancy prevention, and retention indicators into existing National/DLG Results-Based Financing frameworks. Blended & Catalytic Finance Models: Explore feasibility for co-financing mechanisms where UNFPA catalytic funds or development partner grants leverage concessional government borrowing or private sector co-investments. Private Sector & Innovative Financing Mobilization: Private Sector & CSR Mapping: Identify major private sector entities (telecoms, banking, commercial agriculture, energy) operating in Uganda with corporate social responsibility (CSR) or ESG alignment to adolescent empowerment, digital health, and SRHR. Private-Public Partnership (PPP) Models: Design investment packages for private sector participation in digital TPSR reporting platforms, adolescent-friendly health service delivery, or skill-building initiatives for young mothers and youth. Pillar 5: Institutional Capacity Building & Knowledge Transfer Government Ownership: Progressively transfer econometric models, financing dashboards, and analytical tools to technical staff in MoH, MoFPED, MoGLSD, MoES, MoLG and NPA. UNFPA & Partner Capacity: Train the UNFPA Country Office team and government counterparts on interpreting, presenting, and translating financing analytics into high-level policy dialogue: Inception Training (End of Phase 1): Provide a foundational overview of Uganda’s budget cycle, PBB architecture and key fiscal decision points to ensure alignment across teams. Clarify consultant’s scope of work and identify touchpoints requiring UNFPA staff input. Endline Training (Phase 6): Technical transfer of developed econometric models and analytical tools to ensure long-term government and staff ownership. It will also evaluate the impact of the consultancy’s deliverables on recent policy outcomes and establish strategies for sustaining evidence-informed advocacy in future budget cycles. Ad Hoc Technical Orientations: Conduct brief walkthroughs of emerging deliverables to UNFPA staff and government partners as required to gather feedback throughout the project lifecycle and ensure UNFPA & Partner capacity is built. Geographic Coverage The consultancy will focus at national level and specifically on the 13 SAY Plus + programme districts in West Nile, Acholi, Karamoja, Bukedi and Busoga. Evaluation Approach and Methodology The consultant will employ a mixed-methods, health economics, and public financial management approach, including the following: Quantitative Fiscal & Budget Analysis: Expenditure tracking, budget execution modeling, fiscal space assessments, and investment case recalculations. Political Economy & Stakeholder Analysis: Mapping budget decision-makers, incentive structures, and distributive bargaining dynamics within health and fiscal planning cycles. Systems Analysis & PFM Audits: Evaluating resource flows, release schedules, and administrative bottlenecks from central ministries down to District Local Governments (DLGs). Participatory & Capacity-Building Workshops: Conducting technical sessions with parliamentary committees, MoFPED, MoH, MoGLSD, MoES, MoLG and UNFPA staff. Deliverables: Roadmap Phase Core Deliverables & Milestones PFM Cycle Alignment / Target Timeline Payment (%) Phase 1 & Inception Inception Report & PFM Mapping Strategy: Approved inception report, detailed workplan aligned budget cycle, and budget baseline assessment mapping CPD10/SAY Plus financing to the PBB structure. Month 1 September 15% Phase 2 Evidence Suite: Cost of Inaction analysis, updated SRHR/TPSR Investment Case, Financing Factsheets, and Fiscal Space Analysis report. Month 1 September 20% Phase 3 Public Budget Advocacy & MPS Package: PBFP Submission Briefs (Human Capital Development PWG). MOUs with NPA and MoLG for the CPD10 cofinancing agreement with UNFPA. Parliamentary Budget Committee Briefing Kits. MPS Analysis Memo & Final Budget Allocation Report. Month 2-4 25% Phase 4 PFM Bottleneck & Expenditure Efficiency Report: Public Expenditure & Execution Review analyzing fund flows, release delays, procurement efficiencies, and equity metrics for TPSR/SRHR/DD. Month 6-9 (Aligned with Q2/Q3 budget execution reviews) 20% Phases 5 & 6 Financing Diversification Roadmap & Final Synthesis: IFI/Private Sector engagement framework, Results-Based Financing options paper, complete transfer of econometric tools to MoGLSD/MoES/MoH/MoLG/MoFPED staff, and Final Sustainable Financing Synthesis Report. Month 10-11 20% Duration and working schedule: The consultancy is expected to last 100 working days for the Consultant within 11 months- 3 days per week. Delivery dates and how work will be delivered: The consultants will submit electronic versions of the reports for each of the Phases listed in the deliverables. Supervisory arrangements: Direct Supervision: The consultant will work under the direct supervision of the UNFPA Programme Specialist Population and Dynamics / Sustainable Financing Lead, in close coordination with the Gender & Youth Coordinator and SRHR Coordinator. Government Collaboration: Technical work will be executed in close consultation with the MoH Adolescent and School Health Division, MoFPED, National Planning Authority, and the SAY Plus + Secretariat. Technical Backstopping: Methodological review, quality assurance, and peer review of major financial analytics will be supported by the UNFPA East and Southern Africa Regional Office (ESARO) Health Economics / Sustainable Financing Advisors. Qualifications and Experience: Education: Advanced university degree (Master’s) in Health Economics, Public Finance, Economics, Public Policy, Development Economics, or a related field. Knowledge and Experience: Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible experience in health economics, public financial management, domestic resource mobilization, and sustainable financing strategies in developing countries (experience in Uganda strongly preferred). Deep Knowledge of Uganda PFM Law & Processes: Direct, practical understanding of the Public Finance Management Act (PFMA 2015), Programme-Based Budgeting (PBB), the Program Budgeting System (PBS), Budget Call Circulars, and parliamentary budget approval procedures. Fiscal Analytics: Demonstrated expertise in developing Investment Cases, Cost of Inaction analyses, Public Expenditure Reviews (PERs), and fiscal space analyses within health, population, or social sectors. Strategic Policy Engagement: Proven capacity in high-level policy advocacy with Ministries of Finance, Ministries of Health, National Planning Authorities, Parliamentary Committees, and IFIs (World Bank, AfDB). Innovative Finance & PFM: Solid understanding of IFI operations, Results-Based Financing (RBF) frameworks, blended finance, private sector engagement, and conducting PFM execution analyses at national and district levels. Excellent facilitation, training, and strategic communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex economic data into practical policy messages for decision-makers. Languages: Fluency in written and spoken English is required. Required Competencies: Values: Exemplifying integrity, Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system, Embracing cultural diversity, Embracing change Core Competencies: Achieving results, Being accountable, Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen, Thinking analytically and strategically, Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships, Interested consultants are invited to submit the following: Motivation letter A detailed proposal outlining the approach, methodology and budget for the assessment/consultancy. CV of the lead consultant, highlighting past experience working as a lead consultant in similar evaluations Examples of previous relevant work.
